admin.dupes.applyHint: A backup copy of the database is made first. The merge can be undone with "Restore merges".
admin.dupes.intro: Merges two numbers read differently for the same row on the board. The merge moves the observations to the winning number and archives the lost rows; it is reversible. A backup copy of the database is made before every apply.
admin.dupes.restoreHint: Puts back the rows archived by the merges made so far (all batches).
admin.dupes.title: Duplicate train numbers
admin.marks.text: 60 events proposed in the analysis of the old history (mark_apply.sql, event IDs from the Azure history). They are not applied to the current database, because the home database only has data from 31 October. There is no apply button.
admin.marks.title: Proposed OCR13 marks

admin.result.title: {title} · result
admin.sec.emptyTop: No probe request in the last {win}.
admin.sec.intro: IPs banned by fail2ban and their requests from the nginx log. The data comes from an exporter that runs on the server every 2 minutes, read-only; the application has no access to fail2ban. Times are in {tz}. Unknown values appear as "—".
admin.sec.invalid: The file written by the exporter is invalid (unknown format).
admin.sec.noData: The security exporter has not written any data yet (the tabela-security-snapshot timer is not installed or has not run).
admin.sec.note.bannedTruncated: Too many banned IPs: the list is limited to the first 1000.
admin.sec.note.builtin: The fail2ban filter could not be read; probes are counted with the copy of the rule built into the application.
admin.sec.note.f2NoLog: The fail2ban log could not be read: the history comes from the fail2ban database (last day only), 7-day bans are "—".
admin.sec.note.f2Unavailable: fail2ban unavailable: its database could not be read; only the requests from the nginx log are shown.
admin.sec.note.ipsCapped: Too many distinct IPs in the log: the totals are exact, but some IPs have no details (the number of IPs with probes is a lower bound).
admin.sec.note.ipsTruncated: Too many IPs: the details are limited to the first 500.
admin.sec.note.noAccess: The nginx log could not be read: the request count is "—".
admin.sec.note.truncated: Reading the logs stopped at the time limit: the numbers may be incomplete.
admin.sec.stale: Stale data: the last snapshot is {age} old (at {time}, {tz}). Is the exporter on the server no longer running?
admin.sec.title: Security (fail2ban)
admin.vis.title: Online visitors
admin.vis.intro: Visitors with at least one request in the last 5 minutes (bots excluded). IP masked; kept in memory only, lost on restart. Page = last requested path (page or /api call).
admin.push.title: Push notification test
admin.push.intro: Sends a test notification to this browser, to verify Web Push on your phone.
admin.push.gone: The subscription expired; re-enable notifications in the app.
admin.push.noSub: This browser is not subscribed to notifications. Enable notifications first in the app (follow a train), then try again.
admin.push.keyMismatch: This browser's subscription uses an old VAPID key (push 403). Reopen the app (it re-subscribes automatically) and try again.
admin.push.keyMismatchFixed: This browser's subscription used an old VAPID key (push 403). It was renewed automatically, followed trains kept; press again to test.
admin.push.notSubscribed: This browser's subscription is not in the server database.
admin.push.notConfigured: Push notifications are not configured on the server.
